questions.q_en: In a circular race of 1600 m in length, Bhaskar and Vinay start with speeds of 27 km/h and 45 km/h starting at the same time from the same point. When will they meet for the first time on the track when running in the opposite directions and the same direction, respectively?
questions.solution_en:
(a) Opposite Directions:

Convert speeds to m/s:

  27 km/h = (27 X 5/18) = 7.5 m/s,

  45 km/h = (45 X 5/18) = 12.5 m/s.

Relative speed = 7.5 + 12.5 = 20 m/s.

Time = Distance / Relative Speed = 1600 / 20 = 80 seconds = 1 minute 20 seconds.

(b) Same Direction:

Relative speed = Difference = 12.5 - 7.5 = 5 m/s.

Time = 1600 / 5 = 320 seconds = 5 minutes 20 seconds.

Option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: In triangle ABC, AB = 6 cm, BC = 9 cm and AC = 12 cm. If AD is the angle bisector of ∠BAC , where D is a point on BC then DC is :
questions.solution_en:
Given AB = 6 cm, AC = 12 cm

Using the angle bisector theorem :

BD/DC = 6/12 = 1/2

Let BD = x and DC = y

x/y = 1/2

x = y/2

since BD + DC = BC

x + y = 9

putting value of x we get,

y/2 + y = 9

3y/2 = 9

Y = 6 cm

questions.q_en: Abhi and Nikki walk along a circular track in opposite directions. Abhi completes 3 rounds in 1 minute and Nikki completes 4 rounds of the track at the same time. They start from the same point and walk for 2 minutes. How many times will they meet on the track between start time and end time?
questions.solution_en:
They are moving in opposite directions, their relative speed = 3 + 4 = 7 rounds per minute

In 1 minute, they complete 7 rounds together, meaning they meet 7 times per minute.

In 2 minutes, the total number of meetings will be: 7 x 2 = 14 times

questions.q_en: A takes 7 minutes and 45 seconds while B takes 8 minutes to complete a race. A beat B by 80 meters in the race if both start simultaneously from the starting point. Find the length of the course.
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by A = 7 * 60 + 45 = 465 seconds

Time taken by B = 8 * 60 = 480 seconds

B cover distance in 15 seconds = 80 meters

B cover distance in 480 seconds = 480 * 80/15

= 2560 meters

Hence, the length of the course = 2560 meters

questions.q_en: If the area of the base of a regular hexagonal pyramid is 384√3 m2 and the area of one of its faces is 128√3 m2, then find the volume of the pyramid.
questions.solution_en:
Area of base of hexagonal pyramid = 3√3/2 * base2

384√3 = 3√3/2 * base2

Base2 = 256 m2

base = 16 m

Area of one face = 1/2 * base * slant height

128√3 = 1/2 * 16 * slant height

Slant height = 16√3 m

Height = √[(16√3)3 - (16√3/2)2] = 24 m

The volume of the pyramid = 1/3 * area of hexagon * Height of the pyramid

= 1/3 * 384√3 * 24

= 3072√3 m3

questions.q_en: Areas of two circular fields are in the ratio 1: 4. If the radius of smaller circular field is increased by 80% and the radius of larger circular field is decreased by 40%, then area of the circular field which was smaller earlier will become what percentage of the area of the circular field which was larger earlier?
questions.solution_en:
Let radii of smaller and larger circular fields are r and R respectively.

Now, 1: 4 = (πr2)/(πR2) => R = 2r

New radius of field which was smaller earlier = (100 + 80)% of r = 1.8r

New radius of field which was larger earlier = (100 - 40)% of R = 0.6R = 0.6 * 2r = 1.2r

Therefore, required percentage = (new area of circular field which was smaller earlier)/(new area of circular field which was larger earlier) * 100

= (π * 1.8r * 1.8r)/(π * 1.2r * 1.2r) * 100

= 225%
questions.solution_hi:

Now, 1: 4 = (πr2)/(πR2) => R = 2r

questions.q_en: When a number is divided by 3, the remainder is 2. Again, when the quotient is divided by 7, the remainder is 5. What will be the remainder when the original number is divided by 21?
questions.solution_en:
Let the number = (3k + 2)

Now, when the quotient is divided by 7, the remainder is 5.

So, k = 7m + 5

So, the number = (3(7m + 5) + 2) = (21m + 17)

when the original number is divided by 21 = (21m + 17)/21

So, the remainder = 17

Since B got only 950 grams at the cost of 1000 grams and he sold only 750 grams at the cost of 1000 grams.

Let price of 1 gram of apple = 1

Cost of 950 grams of apple = 1000 [When false weight is used]

Selling price of 750 grams of apples = 1000 [When false weight is used]

Selling price of 950 grams of apples = 1000 * (950/750) = 3800/3 = 1266.67

Profit amount = 1266.67 - 1000 = 266.67

Profit percent = (266.67/1000) * 100

= 26.67%
